features.name: log_credit_amount_z
features.description: Standardized log credit amount for smooth linear margin contribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth normalized severity score of loan size for linear separation.

features.name: duration_z
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear projection on duration risk axis; longer loans typically higher risk.

features.name: age_z
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth age signal for linear SVM margin.

features.name: amount_per_month
features.description: Approximate monthly repayment burden (credit_amount divided by duration).
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous severity ratio capturing repayment intensity, useful for linear margins.

features.name: installment_burden_score
features.description: Weighted composite of installment commitment and log credit amount.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two repayment-burden indicators into a single linear-friendly score.

features.name: checking_status_severity
features.description: Ordinal severity of checking account balance (lower balance = higher severity).
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth ordinal projection for linear SVM, captures known strong risk signal.

features.name: savings_severity
features.description: Ordinal severity of savings level (less savings = higher severity).
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear ordinal feature for savings adequacy.

features.name: employment_stability
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures employment tenure on a continuous scale for SVM.

features.name: credit_history_risk
features.description: Ordinal risk encoding from credit history categories.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear severity projection of historical repayment behavior.
features.formula: np.where(credit_history == 'no credits/all paid', 1.0, np.where(credit_history == 'all paid', 0.85, np.where(credit_history == 'delayed previously', 0.6, np.where(credit_history == 'existing paid', 0.35, 0.1))))

features.name: duration_to_age_ratio
features.description: Loan duration relative to applicant age, capturing commitment length vs life stage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth ratio useful for linear separation between younger long-term borrowers and older short-term borrowers.

features.name: applicant_stability_composite
features.description: Semantic judgment score combining housing ownership, property magnitude, telephone ownership, and foreign worker status into an overall financial-stability score (higher = more stable applicant profile).
features.expected_model_benefit: Single dense stability axis aids linear SVM by aggregating weak categorical signals.

features.name: loan_purpose_risk_judgment
features.description: Semantic risk score for loan purpose based on general lending domain knowledge (e.g., new car/business higher risk, used car/radio-tv lower). Encoded on a continuous 0-1 risk axis without using outcome data.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses high-cardinality purpose into a smooth linear-friendly risk score.
